value.rationale: Complete all-inclusion-minimal structural classification and two-variable size enumerator for an infinite standard Johnson/triangular graph family answers a motivated enumeration problem not settled by the known scalar minimum. The explicit four-vertex-path symmetry correction, sharp upper cardinality and coexistence of different minimal cardinalities at n=7 provide substantive information. The result is not a renaming or an isolated table recomputation.
